content: Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
explanation: We are not our passing emotions; we are the vast, open sky in which storms arise and dissolve. By returning awareness to the rhythm of the physical in-breath and out-breath, we anchor consciousness in unwavering calm.
practicalInsight: When hit by an emotional wave of anxiety or irritation today, observe it without judgment and follow your breath for ten counts.
reflectionPrompt: What temporary emotional cloud are you currently mistaking for your permanent identity?
